About Us

Our Story

the biggest party of our lives

Sometimes, the most beautiful love stories begin with the simplest click.

Back in 2018, Charles found me on Facebook through our mutual friends from CPU. What started as a simple friend request became endless conversations, late-night calls, shared dreams, and a connection that neither of us expected would change our lives forever.

Then came the distance.

For almost seven years, our love has been measured not by the miles between us, but by the promises we kept, the sacrifices we made, and the unwavering belief that one day, our paths would finally lead us to the same place. While Charles pursued his career at sea and I built mine overseas, we learned that love isn't about being together every day—it's about choosing each other every single day.

As we stand before our family and friends, saying “I do” is not the end of our long-distance journey, but the beginning of a new chapter. We know that after our wedding, we'll still have to spend some time apart. But this time, everything feels different. Every goodbye brings us closer to our last one. Every sacrifice is another step toward the future we've prayed for—a life where oceans no longer separate us, and home is wherever we are together.

Our story is one of faith, patience, resilience, and hope. It's proof that when two hearts are meant for each other, no distance is too far, no waiting is too long, and no dream is impossible.

This is our story.

And the best part… is still waiting to be written.

Before You Arrive

Gentle Reminders

Unplugged Ceremony

We are having an unplugged ceremony, meaning we kindly ask all guests to put away their phones and cameras. We want everyone to be fully in the moment with us. Don't worry—our professional photographer will capture all the special moments, and we'll be happy to share them with you later!

Arrival

To ensure everything runs smoothly, please arrive at least 30 minutes before the ceremony starts. This will give time to find your seat, take in the beautiful setup, and fully be present for our special moment.

Gifts

With all that we need to start our new life together, your presence is the greatest gift of all. However, if you wish to give further, a monetary gift would be deeply appreciated.

Good to Know

Frequently Asked Questions

Where to stay?

For guests who wish to stay overnight, accommodations are available at the reception venue. Kindly contact the reception page for reservation and inquiries, or reach us directly at 0920 134 8824 or 0905 539 0405.

Can I bring a plus one?

We'd love to include everyone, but unfortunately we're unable to accommodate additional guests. We hope you understand that we've carefully planned our guest list. Thank you so much for understanding!

Is there parking available?

Yes, there are parking spaces available for all guests.
